name: Plainstrider Menace
summary: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends new Horde adventurers after plainstriders east of the outpost. The birds threaten its food supplies, and the hunt gives newcomers a first measure of the Barrens.

sections.title: Securing the Crossroads
sections.body: The Crossroads coordinates supplies across Kalimdor, but plainstriders east of the outpost have begun picking at its food crates. Sergra Darkthorn, an orc shaman, sends newly arrived Horde adventurers to hunt the birds before they damage the stores. Their attacks threaten provisions the settlement depends on.

sections.title: The First Hunt
sections.body: Sergra Darkthorn uses the hunt to measure newcomers as well as protect supplies. She sees the plainstriders as simple prey, fit to teach young hunters to endure the elements and track quarry across the sun-baked plains. Bringing back their sharp beaks shows a hunter has patience and the basic martial skill needed to face fiercer beasts of the Barrens.

faq.answer: Plainstriders east of the Crossroads have grown bold, raiding food supplies and harassing passing supply lines. Sergra Darkthorn orders them hunted to protect the settlement's provisions.

Sergra Darkthorn is an experienced orc shaman stationed at the Crossroads. She oversees hunting trials, trains incoming adventurers, and directs them against wild beasts that threaten Horde operations.

faq.q: Why does Sergra want their beaks specifically?
faq.answer: A plainstrider uses its tough, sharp beak as both its primary weapon and a tool for scavenging. Bringing back the beak proves the bird has been slain.
After the plainstriders, Sergra sends you to hunt zhevra, faster and more spirited prey roaming the plains.
Plainstriders wander the savanna grasslands east and southeast of the Crossroads, foraging along the trade roads.

faq.q: Is this part of a larger hunting series?
faq.answer: Yes. This begins Sergra Darkthorn's hunting trials in the Barrens, which grow more dangerous as they turn to fiercer beasts across the savanna.

angles.text: As a young hunter, you learn to stalk, track, and put down quarry in the wide-open savanna.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect the Crossroads, an essential logistics junction, and secure its food supplies so the Horde can maintain its foothold across Kalimdor.
As an orc, you honor the discipline of the hunt. Sergra expects you to prove your mettle against local beasts before taking on weightier duties.
